vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 40s and A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek are comparing scars like trading cards.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Scott, Carmine, Salvatore and Chaska met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Scott, Carmine, Chaska are hurt.
🛡️ Rebecca, Brian, Nadia and Wanjiru met them at the door — 4 put down. Rebecca, Brian, Wanjiru are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rebecca, Scott, Chaska, Wanjiru and Amina met them at the door — 5 put down. Rebecca, Chaska, Wanjiru, Amina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rebecca, Scott, Brian, Nadia and Wanjiru met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Rebecca, Scott, Brian, Nadia, Wanjiru are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Katarina just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Olivia just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Olivia and Elena met them at the door — 2 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Olivia just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Olivia and Elena met them at the door — 2 put down. Olivia, Elena are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
